description: Film look: full-bleed 9:16 fill, small elegant captions that fade, no zoom, no slam — the footage does the talking.
look: Clean and quiet. The frame is filled edge to edge; captions are small (44px) white with a soft fade; the hook is a small white title that fades in at the top.
name: cinematic
when: Use for beautiful footage — sunsets, city shots, slow moments — where big captions would ruin the frame.
